target_customer: Operations teams at fintech companies running manual onboarding and compliance processes
problem: Fintech operations teams handle onboarding and compliance with manual tasks and human agents. Fragment provides task management and a human supervision layer so AI can take over more steps safely.
business_model: B2B SaaS for operations task management and AI human handoff
product_category: Human in the loop operations software

founders.name: Olivier Moindrot
founders.background_notes: Created and led the AI team at MetaMap, a Series B startup, building internal tools that processed about 1M identity verifications a month with 300 human agents.

founders.name: Guillaume Genthial
founders.background_notes: Led the AI team at a KYC provider. Earlier work on healthcare LLMs, ad recommendation and OCR.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow and task management with AI automation hooks is standard software engineering, but integrating with regulated KYC and compliance flows added hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Task management tools are easy to copy. Integration into compliance workflows and operations data could create some switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sierra acquired the team in April 2026 to strengthen its agent development in France and fill a workflow integration gap.

market_need_then: Fintechs were scaling KYC and compliance operations with large human teams, and the 2023 rise of LLMs raised demand for tooling that mixes automation with human review.

branding.domain_note: Used checkfragment.com rather than fragment.com, so the exact name was unavailable. The host did not resolve from this session.

brand_strength.rationale: No sources show press, community or distinctive assets about the brand. Several other companies share the name Fragment, which causes confusion.

outcome_analysis: Fragment was a two person team with founders who had run AI and human review operations at KYC providers, giving them strong domain insight. Sierra acquired it in April 2026 mainly for the people and know-how and to expand in France, with undisclosed terms, which looks closer to a soft landing than a scaled outcome.
notes: checkfragment.com did not resolve from the session, so the company site is treated as unreachable or dead. Unverified single source figures: a 500K seed from YC in 2023-08 (Seedtable) and a 9M seed in 2024-07 with BoxGroup and others (CB Insights), and the identity of the second is uncertain because several companies are named Fragment. PitchBook estimates about 2M raised per press. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Sierra's announcement is dated 22 April 2026, other reports say 23 April. Success factor and soft landing label are judgments from press framing.
